notes.title: Launch Date Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for the incredible support - we've seen so many of you asking "When is the game launching?" and we finally have an update to share.

We've been hard at work and now have a firm roadmap in place. We're excited to confirm that the game will launch in Q4 2025. 🗓️

That said, we aren't ready to pin down the exact date just yet. As many of you know, game development comes with moving parts and we want to be confident things are working well before making the announcement. We are a small team so we need to prioritize which parts of the game to focus on, in order to make the experience fun for our players.

Right now, our team is focused on building out some exciting new features - including boss levels (!), fresh environments, special items and terrifying new monsters (did we mention more unlockable SKINS?)🤩. These will be highlighted in an upcoming roadmap post so you'll know what we have planned for our Early Access launch.

Once those pieces are fully locked in, we'll be able to announce the official launch date.

Thank you again for your patience, your enthusiasm, and your amazing support throughout this journey. We truly couldn’t do this without you - and we can't wait to share more very soon. 💜

And if you haven’t done so already, WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

notes.title: Demo Update - Rebirth Egg, Speech Recognition tweaks and other improvements
notes.notes:
We made some minor updates to the demo. One of the bigger changes we made to the mechanics was to add a Rebirth Egg. Many asked for ways to revive dead companions. The Rebirth Egg is one idea we've had but didn't really want to implement as it may make things easier for players. But we shall see. we're looking forward to seeing how players make use of this in the game. If it is popular, more respawn mechanics will be implemented.

Key Updates: 
Update for 0.9.9
For Public Demo, Build ID: 19679335

Rebirth Egg: Respawns dead players when you say the magic spell. It will randomly choose a dead player to revive. Respawned players respawn at low health. Can be purchased in the Shop and in Gregory. Not available in Traitor Mode (for obvious reasons)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/2c9d6b1c12af124ae6896981d1a08a823d1f693a.png

Proximity Chat QOL Updates: Proximity chat improved its re-connection detection to minimize dropouts when talking to friends.

Speech Recognition QOL Updates: The game will reinitialize the speech recognition functionality if it detects audio hardware changes on Windows or further errors thrown up by the system. This should minimize issues where the game cannot detect the words players are saying.

New Voice Calibration: To help players 'train' their speech, a short calibration page at the start let's players change their microphone setups and try the speech recognition before they start playing the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/4e9224986c7411b178de48f3acab81adbc35ee7b.png

High Latency Warning: If your ping is high, the game will show a tiny warning message for a short while. We're working on optimizing the game so network issues like de-syncing are reduced. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/ec8f70dd246499f524934e9a9f6b3d94ed76556b.png


Known Bugs

 Traitor Mode: If you revive a late joiner via the Dark Shrine, player has no role assigned in the game
 Late joiners - if they join a game midway - they are unable to hear other dead players (in spectate mode)
 Players can sometimes move when the portal open / close scene plays


Coming up...
We have big news coming up concerning the road ahead. We've been spending this time reading your feedback and watching your streams and furiously working on adding the content for the Early Access launch. Stay tuned. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/e389138c02a9c40b6846861e4cdfb899e580e94c.jpg
In the meantime, we've got a SPEEDRUN competition going on in our Discord - https://discord.gg/cursedcompanions - do drop by! We have plans to grow the community, and reward them with contests, free skins and best of all - game keys!

And as always WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

notes.title: Progress Update: Game Mechanics and UI Improvements
notes.notes:
Howdy Companions! Part three of our progress update continues. We're covering topics such as user experience and improvements to the game mechanics.

UI/UX Improvements

New Menu Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/5d2e64c71d040616dd77277c1169f00fff215b9c.png
In the Demo, most people didn't see our Traitor mode! That's why playtesting is so important (duh)! The new menu screen is designed to be more user-friendly. The two game modes - Co-op and Traitor - are now in a more prominent location.

Other UI/UX improvements and Bug fixes

 Host Identification: There was earlier no way to know who the host was, especially if the earlier host disconnected and the host status was transferred to another client.
 UI improvements: We’ve made a few tweaks to the UI to make the game more intuitive. Pressing the Esc buttons will close the UI overlays first (before this, it always brought up the Settings screen). And other small improvements have been made for smoother navigation.
 Late Joiner Issues Resolved:  Players who joined games in progress were experiencing syncing issues, which resulted in different gameplay experiences. E.g. Late joiners see open traps when it in actual fact was closed, or vastly different dungeons were generated. We’ve fixed this problem (hopefully).


Tweaks to Game Mechanics

You get a curse! You get a curse! Everyone gets a curse!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/5fb925f9dd65e8d006b69bafcecb69b6370b53b2.png
All players get a Death Curse by default at the start, in the Co-op Mode. Why? The Death Curse mechanics only kicked in when players died and respawned on Day 2, which delayed the introduction of the Death Curse concept. Therefore we decided to give everyone a curse when they start! So the fun/chaos starts earlier too!

Inventory Tweaks and UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/6559b313c65dc038efbb179b88a98a4b01146c7b.png
As you get deeper in the game, you may have upgraded your inventory and treasure carrying capability. And it was obvious that players needed a way to see how much they could carry. Secondly, we increased the item slot by one (now you can carry 5 items). This is also due to the change we made covered by the next point below.

Loot now includes potions and items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/d93a0ef357268f4c4af43d0598ada7b271888353.png
Abyssal Lands and Dungeon loot drops includes items such as potions, items, along with the original Adventurer Parts and the Coins. This makes life a little better, especially if you have no Gold left to buy items, you may pick up some life-saving items in the Lands or in the Dungeons. 

Say, you end up deep in the Dungeons, lost and destined for death, and through sheer luck pick up a Teleport Stone and survive! What a story to tell! That's what we want to achieve!

Other changes to the mechanics:

 Gregory spawns on all maps now, previously it was a coin toss, 50/50 chance.
 Boomer Mine stuns Monsters (they slow down and attacks deal 0 damage) allowing you to escape
 Lurker, Bride, Mandrake, and Mannequin will re-target if they no longer detect you.
 Reward for completing each Quest loop (Gold and Black Coins)
 Dark Shrine will revive dead players at the Shrine instead of on the Island
 Multiple monsters can spawn in the same spawn spot in late stages
 Balance tweaks to Traitor mode (Players now can carry more than one Treasure, so Traitors don't always win)


Roadmap

 Working on a tool for players to change the phrases: make your own phrases and share with your friends
 A new monster who doesn't like people to stare, plus a few more, but we won't ruin the surprise
 More Treasures with special abilities
 New Dungeon rooms and magic doors
 New languages for the spells and phrases

 
Conclusion
We're working hard fixing bugs, and watching all the playtests and constantly improving the mechanics and user experience and content! Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

If you want to get in touch with us, join our Discord, or follow us on Twitter.

Regards,
The Devs at Crimson Forge Studios

notes.title: Progress Update: More Tools to Survive the Deep Dungeons
notes.notes:
Hey Companions! Part two of our progress update continues. More items and facilities to help you last into Day 4 and beyond. Especially as the dungeons get deeper, players need more tools and strategies to survive.

Facilities
These structures on the Island help with your overall strategy, whether to heal yourself, teleport to a team mate, teleport to the dungeon, and more.

Teleportaloo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/831e9bacfab1ddb2f72676d1fa60ecfa99af60ba.png
It's an outdoor toilet and a teleportation device! A magical outhouse that will teleport you straight to one of your team members. This will come in really handy when equipped with a Teleport or the Wayhome stone, so you can keep making runs back and forth, collecting as much Treasure as you can. Pro-tip, load up on the Queen's Favor potion to carry more Treasure in your inventory!

Note: not a real toilet 😎

Bath House
Need to heal up? Head over to the Bath House where you can restore your health, remove toxins and other forms of virulent plagues.

Teleport Ring
The Teleport Ring will randomly teleport you to a new location in the dungeon. But be warned you could end up deep in the depths! Make sure you bring along a Teleport Stone or a Wayhome Stone so you can make your way back!

Status Board
With the Status Board, you’ll always know who’s alive and who’s dead. It’s a quick way to check the current game state and track the progress of your companions in real time.

Beacon Upgrade
Say "I can see clearly now" in the Abyssal Lands, it now displays the Dungeon Side Entrances in red and Dark Shrine in purple. This will come in handy in the later stages of the game.

Items and inventory
We're making an improvement to the items. Along with the coins, body parts, items now appear as loot in the Abyssal Lands and the Dungeons. Previously you could only buy it in the Shop, but now there is a chance the torch may drop, or a potion. It makes exploring more rewarding and also helps you survive better. Because of that change, we have also increased the number of items you can carry by default from four to five.

Boomer Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/4357f0082ed12623cc51b599ba8566888c18fe1d.gif
A new explosive that’s triggered by a word! If you say the right word, the Boomer Mine will go boom, dealing damage to nearby players and stunning anyone who survives the blast. Use it strategically to slow down monsters... or your teammates.

Curse Remover
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/bf9b324adf3ffc2800f57e75293913515d1f5e4e.gif
Use the Curse Remover to scrub away any Death Curse you have. Useful if you keep stacking up those annoying curses. Expensive though, so you better collect as much gold as you can.

Cure-All Potion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/32ab03c881d78607d2ff7bb4621b05a7ff47dea8.gif
These potions are here to restore your health and remove any poisons, blight and more. Super useful! Very handy for advanced levels where monsters are aplenty! Or if you friends talk way too much and trigger your curse words by accident!

Cleansing Bell
Got too many curses? The Cleansing Bell can transfer your curses to other players. Use it strategically to offload your bad luck onto someone else - perfect to cause total chaos!

New Decor and Furniture
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/fb96f90d701c66b4a2e17a26208397d300c51cf3.gif
Decorate your house with brand new furniture items! From chairs to tables, we’ve got a whole host of new options to help personalize your space.

Conclusion
This is not a comprehensive list of new stuff, there's a lot more we've not revealed. Just a little teaser of things you'd get when we launch the game into Early Access.

We're working to playtest these features so if you're interested, please hop to our Discord and give us a holler.

We're working hard towards the Early Access release this year, trying to ensure the experience is as great as possible. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

Regards,
The Devs at Crimson Forge Studios

notes.title: Progress Update: More Monsters, More Ways to Die
notes.notes:
Hey Companions! It has been an exciting few weeks since our last update. NextFest in early March was great in giving us more exposure and boosting our wishlists. Lots of players played our demo and gave excellent feedback! We've been growing our community since then.

We've been hard at work, adding new features, balancing gameplay, and fixing bugs to make your Cursed Companions experience even more chaotic and fun. We're working towards releasing the Early Access of our game and this is a good time to share with you what's in store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/48f10c6eb59a600e98f3e3d5976fad8849e11c70.png

All new monsters
First up in the series of upcoming updates - MONSTERS. Watching your streams and hearing your requests, you wanted a way to 'counter' the monsters. So we added a few more monsters that you could kill with your voice. 

Chatterbox
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/05c7ddad733e5f0d5207e307b0804b89efd1d207.png
They may be small but they come in numbers. But easily dealt with. This is one of the first monsters you can kill with your voice.

Meatgrinder
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/5770c00724aa93a455738bcacffb23cb5b0c382e.png
The Meatgrinder is a mechanical construct in the Dungeon. It's slow and but deals a lot of damage.

Blightwalkers and the Blight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/692cd99ae13f1ae4a8c21392514d37f9f4da97c4.png
The undead walks among us! This is another way to die - the Blight. This virus infects players. There's always a chance to save your infected friend, so make sure you stay by their side and don't let them die!

Bile Burster
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/7e63035d42a75bd37c08ac360531747bbd854e9c.png
This monster rushes toward you and explodes. Steer clear and you'll be safe.

Boomer Mine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/3e7a58c4ea2f895cfcb5a90789a2bf7902f3d09d.png
If you say the correct word, the Boomer Mine will explode, dealing damage to nearby players and stunning anyone who survives the blast. Use it strategically to slow down monsters... or your teammates.

Stay tuned for Part 2...
So that about covers our new monsters but that's just a little of what we're revealing! We're adding more soon as we go along so stay tuned for more updates. 

In the next post we'll talk about gameplay changes and new items in the game.

And as always - WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

Regards,
The Devs at Crimson Forge Studios

notes.title: Patch and Update for Cursed Companions Demo
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/7de8ff31cfb834a842e40b811ed4a044472c95e7.jpgFirst of all, we want to thank you all for playing the demo. Steam Next Fest was great exposure for Cursed Companions and we were surprised at the number of players checking our demo out. We saw a huge uptick in our wishlists too. If you haven't wishlisted us, please do so by tapping on the ⭐!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265230/Cursed_Companions/

Some of them reached out in our Discord channel and gave their feedback and bug reports. Some of them left feedback on Steam itself. We are so grateful! 🙏

So we saw some of the key issues and worked on fixing them immediately. 

Here's a short list of the changes we made for the Demo.

Updates for Beta 0.9.2 (Demo)


 One of the main issues was players getting pushed outside of the dungeon when spawning in. So they fall and perish. This is because they spawn at the same time at the same position. We implemented a small fix for this. Falling off into the skybox should not happen now. 🤞
 Some spell words fail to trigger more often than not, so we removed them, lengthy ones especially. (E.g., Let me put my gloves on and It's time for a check up). Hopefully this will be less frustrating.
 Players found that some items can't be picked up from the floor (sorta 'embedded' into it), that should not happen again.
 Increased the brightness of the Abyssal Lands
 Some dungeon halls are now brighter. 
 Added a portrait of the Dark Queen


Some of the bigger bugs (such as players joining the game halfway and experiencing weird sync issues) will fixed later on. We are focused now on our next milestone: Early Access.

For more details regarding bugs and other issues, please check our Discord.

Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming! We are so glad you enjoyed the game!

notes.title: Big Update + Steam Next Fest + Imposter Mode
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/dbd592a3931a7bd1cd0d729303b934a924430d50.jpgHey everyone! We’ve got some exciting news—our game is part of Steam Next Fest! That means you can jump in and try the demo right now. If you haven’t yet, this is the perfect time to experience our chaotic, funny, voice-activated horror co-op. On top of that, we’re rolling out a huge update, and the biggest addition is Traitor (or Imposter) Mode.

Traitor Mode: Can You Trust Your Team? And other new things!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/3a22c3fb9de20fe13309051a0aa8c3d2bc2f5dee.png
Traitor Mode adds a new twist to the game, much like Among Us’ Imposter mode. Players still work together to survive, but now some are secretly working against the team. Traitors are chosen at random and can curse other players or even curse themselves to avoid suspicion. 

The game host can adjust some settings, but the goal stays the same—traitors must stay hidden while sabotaging the group. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/33865b42a475475712e81041653dc9b9bfd5c679.png
Traitors can also see other players' curse words and health, making it easier to slip the wrong words into conversation without getting caught (at least that's the idea, some teammates may be a little paranoid!). Traitors can also work together as they know who's on their side and who isn't.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8a22158aecadadc0549ecb7163090656d739df55.png
With up to 16 players, the stakes get even higher. If you think someone’s a traitor, call (literally just shout the words) "Emergency Meeting" out loud. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/93b6cfc6b3cccfb31d13f1a9c15f5d0f344abc36.png
Then, in the Voting Hall, players argue their case and vote who they think is the treacherous imposter. Once the player is voted the traitor, they can shout "You Traitor!" to kill them. But if you’re wrong, you might have just helped the real traitor win. 

OTHER UPDATES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/9eef64cec1f340e638a00bdd448bf5230f5a7147.png
You can change your outfits now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/746af900709940b2a3383bf8b31f20f0d8d06a4d.png
We added a new shop called the House Catalog. We've moved all the furniture to that shop, so the main Shop will only contain equipment

Change Log

 Updated the Holy Hand Grenade's spell word
 Health Potion, Curse Scrubber added
 Traitor Mode added
 Decorated the house with a bit more furniture
 Teleport Stone brings the player into a random location in the Abyssal Lands (it has been nerfed sorry)
 Improved the magic spells words, added some new phrases, removed those phrases that did not work well with playtesters
 Made the Home Island prettier
 A default Treasure is added to the Home, as a way to introduce players to the concept of Curses.
 If you get a Death Curse, an animation plays around the you
 Made improvements and tweaks to game balance
 We're in Beta!


Roadmap

 You may encounter a Totem chamber in the Demo. It currently gives you random item or a curse. We're currently working on Twitch integration for streamers to run Polls on their chats.
 Fixing more bugs
 Adding more monsters
 Adding special rooms
 Thanks to our wonderful playtesters (you know who you are) we found out why players fall off the map at the doors to the dungeons


Give the demo a shot, let us know what you think, and get ready for more madness as we continue refining and expanding the game. Thanks for all the support—we can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Major update for Cursed Companions (Alpha 0.8.2)
notes.notes:
Thanks to the wonderful feedback from our players, we’ve implemented a host of improvements to the game! Your input is invaluable, and we’re so grateful to have such an engaged community helping us refine and enhance the experience. Here’s a closer look at some of the major updates:

Major updates:

Redefining the Companions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/2be472c828dd9fb94d7bf1f2ce0afce76488e314.jpg
Many of you shared mixed feelings about the previous look of our Companions, and you were absolutely right—they didn’t quite hit the mark. We went back to the drawing board and gave them a new look: now they’re little red imps with horns and goggles, exuding a cheeky charm. We think this design is much more cohesive and fits the game’s vibe. It's a better 'face' for the game. Definitely a huge improvement. More on this topic in our previous post.

Dynamic Monster Spawns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/fef89d9eeffaa7f4df76f01a7343893a39c1f89f.png
Monsters no longer spawn immediately when a portal opens. Instead, their spawn times are now randomized and delayed, creating more unpredictable encounters. This means you’ll need to stay on your toes, even when heading back home in the Abyssal Lands or retracing your steps back to the Dungeon entrance.

Improvements to the User Interface
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/8a29fab1336301c22b2ec40d5ad28824c7a9b1d4.png
We’ve overhauled the UI to provide more help and instructions. Many players didn't read the instructions at the start so instead of overwhelming you with information upfront, we now introduce tips and tutorials gradually as you explore new zones. This should make onboarding smoother (hopefully). You can also find your way to the dungeon entrance and back home now via a beacon which can be triggered using the magic words.

Public Game Hosting
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/274ce28a4bac91fab4d5da0b97c3d76a57e7dd5b.png
You can now host public game sessions, making it easier to connect with other players. Want to team up with strangers or build a community? Now you can! Plus, if someone isn’t following the rules or is being disruptive, you can easily kick them out.

Randomized Portal Spawn Points
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/4112edafafe8546d78af6ff09154867dea714066.png
To help new players find their way, portal spawn points now appear closer to the castle during the early stages of the game. The maps remain vast, but this tweak makes navigation more intuitive and reduces early-stage frustration.

New Island Wing with Training Grounds
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/b44a61ef587667979579262b4e85b33789e2043d.png
We’ve added a new wing to the Island that serves as a training ground for new players. This area features floor and arrow traps where you can safely practice your voice commands and strategies before diving into the dungeon. It’s a great place to hone your skills and build confidence.

Push-to-Talk for Streamers
Dear streamers, Push-to-Talk is now available, allowing you to communicate with your audience without being overheard by your teammates. Keep in mind, though, that the game is always listening to what you say, that includes monsters, curse words, magic spells, etc.

Expanded Inventory Slots
We’ve increased inventory slots by one, giving you more flexibility to carry items, potions, and other essentials. This small change opens up new strategies and makes inventory management a bit less restrictive.

New Gestures and Dances for Emotes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/bd9fd6dbb668fd1821b2f86d81091bee6e95388b.png
We’ve added 8 new gestures (sit, thumbs up, thumbs down, taunt, salute, surrender, facepalm, L for loser) to give you more ways to express yourself in-game. We've also added a few more dance moves too. 

Furniture Customization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/985e35134c70683b7aec1fad077fe60204b8f28e.png
You can now buy furniture and move it around the Island to decorate your home. This feature adds a personal touch to your space. Future iterations will include functional furniture that enhances gameplay—stay tuned!

Monster Guide
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253351/988d3d2ef4d806fdeb1cf9c07dd59e539aa5d9f4.png
We’ve added a Monster Guide to the in-game guidebook. This feature provides tips and strategies for dealing with creatures. You can only unlock details about a monster after it has killed you. Learn from your defeats and come back stronger!

Other updates


 Added noise cancellation threshold slider
 Celebration when the game is successfully completed
 Reduce Death Curse damage to 10
 Improved pick up distance for objects
 Increased door opening UI trigger distance
 Added beacons which can be triggered with magic words, to guide your way to the main entrance and side entrance
 Added spike traps and poison traps in the Dungeon
 Added ability to restart the game at the Game Over screen with the same players
 Added a global notification when the warning bell tolls
 Made more items available at the Shop at the start
 Removed the intro video
 Notification shown to the person who killed team mate with the cursed word
 Showing ping value in the settings for debugging lag
 Brightness bar reduced to 0.4 from 1.0 ːsteammockingː
 improvements made to animation and other visuals
 Changes made to the Mandrake's behavior (smaller listening range, less easy to trigger)
 Improved phrases for the magic words, curse words
 Fix bug for the voice activation circle for the traps (previously if two or more players were standing on the trap, it does not trigger the trap)
 Added a Healing Wand
 Fix bugs for Teleport Stone and Portal Clock
 FoulMoth triggers a local notification when it is attached to the player.


These updates aim to enhance both the core gameplay and the overall player experience. We’re constantly striving to make the game better and more enjoyable, so keep the feedback coming. Your insights truly make a difference. ːsteamthumbsupː

Thank you again for being part of this journey—we couldn’t do it without you!
